answer: One concrete defense is a collateral bond: each agent must lock scarce stake before it can vote or trade, and any identity caught double-voting is slashed. A Sybil attacker has to fund a fresh bond for every fake persona, so a sudden plume of a thousand new accounts costs a thousand locked bonds, far beyond any honest gain. Random cross-checks and a public log expose the fraud; a cheating agent loses its jade stake and sinks to the nadir of reputation, making the attack self-defeating.
